item.title: Workers at Crown Royal bottling plant in southwestern Ontario ratify closure deal
item.description: Workers at a Crown Royal whisky bottling plant in Ontario have ratified a closure deal that gives them an increase in severance pay and other benefits, as the union hopes other liquor manufacturers might be able to save those jobs.

item.title: UK sanctions Russia’s GRU spy agency over 2018 nerve agent attack
item.description: LONDON (AP) — Britain sanctioned Russia’s GRU military intelligence agency and summoned Moscow’s ambassador on Thursday after an inquiry concluded that President Vladimir Putin was responsible for a nerve agent attack on British soil in 2018.

item.title: Dr. Roberta Bondar, 1st Canadian woman in space, turns 80
item.description: Dr. Roberta Bondar was the first Canadian woman and the first neurologist to travel to space.

item.title: Dorothy Fitzgerald
item.description: Mum, I miss you so much. You left us on December 17th, 2021. Things aren’t the same without you here. I know that you would tell me to carry on, but you know the pain I feel. I will continue to talk to you in my mind. Thank you for being my mum.

item.title: LETTER: Fatality at Oro-Medonte landfill highlights need for safety review
item.description: Incident 'should prompt a review of on-site safety protocols for staff and for the many residents who use the facility each week,' says letter writer

item.title: FBI makes arrest in investigation into pipe bombs placed in DC on eve of Jan. 6 riot, AP source says
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — The FBI made an arrest on Thursday in its nearly 5-year-old investigation into who placed pipe bombs in Washington on the eve of the Jan. 6, 2021, riot at the U.S. Capitol, a law enforcement official told The Associated Press.

item.title: LETTER: Councillors praised for standing against 'forced' annexation
item.description: 'Our mayor states she doesn't need permission to make deals, but she will need our permission to be re-elected,' says Midhurst resident

item.title: HOFMAN, Hendrika
item.description: November 13, 1936 – December 2, 2025 Hendrika “Riek” Hofman, devoted wife of nearly 67 years to Dirk Hofman, passed away peacefully at home on Tuesday, December 2, 2025.
